architecture_observations: The page remains the state and service owner. Extracted children receive display props and emit typed navigation intent; the active step and clinical workflow stay in the page.

Page generation plus route identity guard every inspected asynchronous load/mutation continuation; route changes and unmount invalidate the generation. The page test covers stale route responses and route identity behavior.

Clinical writes fail closed unless a record exists and is open and the encounter context exists and is not closed. Context lookups use Promise.allSettled; failed encounter lookup leaves the write guard false.

Clinical entry creates/updates/archives use idempotency keys tied to stable payload or mutation identity, then refresh and confirm the persisted entry before clearing the draft or reporting success. Clinical-sheet sections are submitted separately, so a partial failure can leave earlier sections persisted; the page reports that condition and instructs the operator to preserve the draft and reread before retrying.

Local clinical-sheet drafts use the shared unsaved-change composable, which guards route leave/update and beforeunload without browser storage. Tests cover protecting a draft before departure and retaining newer edits made during a save.

Attachment opening requires available scan status, asks the API for a download URL, checks expected attachment path, API origin, token and future expiry, and checks the route generation before opening. JSDOM tests validate URL rejection/opening decisions, not a real browser download.

The tests cover route loading and stale response behavior, open/closed read-only cases, attachment URL checks, idempotent writes, draft preservation, partial failure, and reread confirmation using mocks; they do not establish backend authorization, transactionality, audit behavior, or durable persistence.
